title: The ML series — acts, a generated score, word-cued sound
_note: Forked 2026-10-08 from plain-lecture-2 for the ML videos (the human: 'the machine learning videos should have their own template'). bindings are plain-lecture-2's, byte for byte, PLUS `finish` — so binding M1 here re-renders nothing upstream.

writer.doc: Vault: Projects/Videos/Machine Learning/ — HOUSE STYLE — The Failure Is the Spine (questions, failure openings, spoken equations)
writer.sentence: Say the thing, show the thing, move on.
writer.register: Short declaratives. No em-dash chains. No 'not X, it is Y'. Second person, present tense. Every formula carried by the prose around it.
writer.acts: Each chapter heading in the screenplay is an ACT: it gets its own score in its own mood and is joined to the next by a dip through black.
writer.length_rule: 25–30 minutes is the target, not a wall — a little over or under is fine when the content asks for it. Material that would run an hour is SPLIT into modules, never compressed into one; the split is a registry decision (two slugs), not a script decision. At ~150 wpm (speed 1.15) that is roughly 3,000–4,350 words of narration. Education is the point; entertainment is the window into it.
writer.cold_open: Five short beats, one animation resolving through them, no bed.
writer.music_policy: A generated score per act (Stable Audio 3.0, analog-synth sci-fi, E-flat minor). Never a hard cut: dips and blends only. Act I opens on the chosen Analog-awe take; the last act returns to it.
writer.sound: Sound effects are cued to spoken words (shot list: a beat's `sfx`). A cue whose word is gone fails the build before anything renders.

bindings._note: Only keys a shot list block may carry belong here: they land in beats/ fragments byte for byte. Prose about policy goes under `writer`.

score.tail: , serious documentary science-fiction score, cinematic, instrumental, E-flat minor

card._card: 2026-10-09, the human: a title card per act, new music fading in while it hangs 2-4 s; no fade on the voice. The dip between acts falls on the held tail and the card, never on narration.
